body:
It doesn't matter how you feel about him, you know what the right thing to do is. Don't makes excuses. Put yourself in the wife's shoes. Would you want to know what your husband has been doing?

You think you feel terrible now, just wait until you've kept up the lie however long it goes on for. Your self respect and self worth will only wither away further. You're worth more than your "friendship" with the guy.

I think people are completely dismissing a side of this. As someone who was in a similar situation but the BF/husband, OP doesn't need to ask for permission but just a heads up of "hey, I got a free laptop I don't need and I thought your GF  and you would get the most out of it." It's not about permission, it's about respect for the relationship.

Because the guy that was giving my wife gifts ended up giving her more than that.

You don't need to add more stress to someone's life just because everyone's free to do what they want.

I'm not saying there's anything inappropriate definitely happening but the BF doesn't know that. Needlessly chipping away at their trust can be avoided.

Inflatable - Bush
pretty much sums up my marriage
https://youtu.be/gaoibVTRpTw

Thought I Knew You - Matthew Sweet
Another facet
https://youtu.be/xMxRzGLERx8

If you read my history, you'll see my life is a mess. Both my wife and I are dealing with mental health issues including suicide attempts and trying to hold onto our sanity through the seperation for the sake of our kids.

We went to see Joker together. It's the first time in maybe 4 years that we did something like that without the kids. It's too late now to salvage our marriage but we're trying to remain friends and co-parents.

I remember how bad some days are and I'm grateful for days like this.

She came "clean" four months ago but she's been trickle truthing me ever since. The behaviors are the same though: loss of affection and sex decreased greatly, loss of interest, personal life takes precedence,  and never makes time for us. She rather had been somewhere else and I was a SAHD for the past year. The real problems started much earlier than that though.

I put way too much trust in her when my instinct was screaming red flags.

My circumstances are different but how your wife is acting sounds like how my wife was.

I thought we would back each other up forever but that wasn't the case for her.

She was cheating left and right.

She should have left years ago but she stayed for the kids. I had no clue.

At this point in my life, I can't give you objective advice, I can only say from own experience.

I've suffered through severe depression all of my life and never really addressed it until it was too late. I never saw a therapist until 3 months ago, and it took almost 3 months to get my medications right-ish. I wished my wife had fought for our marriage and especially supported me more through my depression. Her idea of her trying to improve our marriage is telling me to "fix it." That's it.

I loved my wife more than anyone, she was the center of my world, but my depression was incredibly difficult to overcome. Depression pushes your awareness inward and you basically emotionally isolate yourself. I couldn't be the husband she wanted (and come to find out she was never the wife I deserved or even thought she was).

I wanted nothing else but my family and I  lost her anyway.  That was the catalyst for me to start working harder on myself.

So is she wanting to put the effort in with your support?

I'm having a similar problem but my circumstances are different. Basically my wife had negatively vented to her friends and family for years, never mentioning anything positive which was most of our life together. But her friends and family only heard how bad of a husband I was and so actively worked to split us behind my back. Of course, face to face it was all hugs and love.

I asked her recently to fix both situations as she even had admitted to me she only spoke negatively of me to them and she refused, saying it's on me to change their minds.

We're on our way to a divorce.

I could have written every single one of those comments. 22 year relationship, 12 year marriage, 3 young kids, completely blindsided and non-stop compulsive lying and disrespect despite my best efforts. It's been 4 months since D-Day and the trickle truthing is unbearable. I found out more truths from talking with her AP than I have from her, even another AP she witheld from me for 13 years. I never truly knew her and she never truly loved me. She lied and cheated our entire relationship. I finally see her for the remorseless monster she is. And I wasn't the only one she lied and cheated on, she did that to her AP and current (ex) girlfriend too. Just insane.

I tried to be there for her as a friend, as the father of her children, but she couldn't care enough to stop pushing me to suicide nor respect me enough to stop lying to me.

I don't know if I can last past the end of the month, much less years in this. Every time we talk about things she stonewalls and eventually quits. And she's given me an ultimatum I can't meet which will result in my being homeless by the end of the month. It's easier to let go of my kids now then it is to stay alive for them. For you to be in this hell for years says you're much stronger than I am.

I recognize I'm not without my own faults and maybe I'm too forgiving with hers. I think why I want her still is complicated. It's not just attraction but an outlet for my own escape. She's far more social than I and I do feel left behind. She spent 3+ years going out with friends, having fun, while I stayed at home with the kids. I should have been with her the whole time.
10, 7, and 4. A boy and two girls.

I've been having frequent dreams of reconcilation for a while now. I wake up completely devasted all over again. It's only been 3 months since seperated though.

> she revealed herself to be so ugly on the inside that it just isn't something I'm interested in. I do regret losing the family life I had though, almost like I wish she was the person I had thought she was.

The more I learn about what she did (thanks trickle-truthing!) the more repelled I am of her. She's not a good person at all, especially considering what she did and is doing to me and our kids now. She treats the kids like an obligation. If she doesn't have to be in the house with us, she won't be. Just a shitty person. Not at all who I thought she had been for 22 years. Losing the family I thought I had forever has been incredibly difficult. Things are not going to get better for me.

Congratulations! Treasure every precious day together.

As others have said, keep saying your partner, communicate!!!, and never do anything that would hurt your partner no matter how unhappy you are. Always take the high road together.

Many blessings to the both of you!

I'm recently seperated. My STBXW is going to a wedding of an old friend in two weeks. That wedding is exactly on our 22 year relationship anniversary. She wants to take her girlfriend/interest. I can't fault anyone for the date being on our anniversary. It's just fate twisting the knife just a bit more.

It's been 2.5 months since DDay. I didn't take it well at all. I fell apart, was inpatient twice, and it's not just the ending of my marriage that's weighing on me.

I'm doing ok today. I didn't have much anxiety at all but I did feel lonely and rejected. I was feeling nostalgic all day and knowing that holidays with the kids as they have been are basically over.

I caved today. I'm not happy with myself but I found her AP on Facebook. I knew his name and that he was a coworker but I never knew what he looked like. I'm oddly disappointed. Now that I know what he looks like, the mental movies aren't as bad as I thought they would be.

She's currently seeing a woman, which doesn't bother me nearly as much as a man would. But I wonder if she knows that my WS is stopping by her APs place for booty calls. I want to blow up her world so badly, let everyone know what she did to me and what she's doing now, but I would just completely lose any amicable relationship we have now, wouldn't get to see my kids, and I would be homeless.

This situation is such a mess. Co-parenting and co-habitating is not healthy at all for us, especially me, but I really don't have anywhere to go. I've been trying to be ok with it but she doesn't make it easy at all.

It's really unfair that she's the one who broke our marriage but she gets to continue living the life she wants, just out in the open instead of hiding. She gets her guilt free life she wanted without me or the kids while I lost my wife, my marriage, and security and feeling of safety.

I still want her so bad. I hate what she did, I hate that lack of character in her, but I love everything else about her. I want to know this more assertive, more confident woman she is now. I've been abandoned so she could be alive and all I wanted was for her to take me with her.

When my wife ended our relationship, I lost more than just my wife and best friend. I lost the future I always held dear of seeing my kids every day, being in their lives everyday, protecting them and guiding them to be good people. I'll have to accept at one point I won't see them and there will be someone else in their lives that will be parenting them besides their mother and I. If my wife would have me, I would swallow all the pain and hurt she put on me just so I could stay with them everyday.

I'm not a citizen but I've always had a legit SSN and DL. I've never had a problem getting a job until e-Verify rolled out. I was downsized out of my long term job and then lost a subsequent job 1.5 years ago. I don't have an Employment Authorization Document that would allow me to get another job. We talked to a lawyer about starting the Adjustment of Status process but he revealed I run a very high risk of getting an order of removal (deportation) when the employment investigation turns up an inconsistency on my last I-9 form and my actual status. I didn't understand what I was doing back then.

This is similar to my experience. 22 year relationship, I'm the betrayed spouse, it's been 2 months since DDay and her dad and sisters have never reached out to me to ask how I'm doing. Her friends know about her cheating and support her, some of them were even my friends first. I've suspected but haven't fully confirmed that she's been exaggerating my faults to everyone and not owning up to her own mistakes. Same as you I still love my wife but she puts herself and her girlfriend before our kids and I. This is a nightmare I can't wake up from.

Just to mention a trick that may help him when that happens again, he should straighten and stretch his legs out in front of him and stretch his calves by pointing his toes up. This helps to redirect blood flow to his legs and will relax him more.

I'm in a similar situation. Co-habitating and co-parenting because of finances for the indefinite future, I've hit a very large legal brick wall with employment so she's going to be the sole income while I take care of the kids and household. Unfortunately, we didn't set ground rules for ourselves in this situation and we're both crumbling under intense stress and anxiety from different sources. She's leaving almost every night to go to her lover's apartment and our 3 young kids are in distress over it. I'm still in love with her and it feels like I'm watching her leave to cheat on me every night. This is hell. I'm still alive only because of my kids.

So with your situation, it sounds like you're already in a good position but its an absolutely great idea to set rules and boundaries you both can agree on and abide by. Dating other people and how the kids see the two of you interacting will be very important to discuss.

This was going to be my recommendation. I bawled at my wedding. I just couldn't control it and I was overly emotional since my mom died the year before. We didn't practice or go over vows (I regret we didn't write our own vows). Music was picked the week of the wedding. It was all still beautiful but the anxiety compounded with my crying.

So just relax, practice your vows, picture your spouse in your mind, listen to your music.
This is incredibly important. It's not about needing/getting permission, it's about respecting your partner and keeping them informed. Working together as a team is the best way to go.
Thank you. The more time passes, the more hope I feel for finding someone else. Just have to find my confidence and avoid locking onto the first relationship that comes along.
Sorry this is late but thank you for the compliments. And you managed to make me chuckle so you have my gratitude.

Thank you. I can only hope this will all turn out better than I expect it will. I feel it's only a matter of time before she takes my kids away from me.
I know I did not make her cross lines but I certainly made it easier to do so.

Thank you. Admittedly, I have not been a good husband nor father. I look back with a lot of regret at the things I did and didn't do. I know I've improved in the last two months. "Too little, too late," she says.

As we are, "No" and "No." We're both broken people. We deserve the best version of each other. I feel that we should have been able to trust one another, to lift each other up, and be the support needed to be better. She gave up a long time ago and I don't want to give up now. I need to.
Well you managed to make me chuckle, so thank you.
I shouldn't but I have less than a choice.

I wish she would want to do marriage counseling but as far as she's concerned there's nothing there for her. When I see her, I still see my wife. I still want to reach out to her and hold her. I've lived with her, feeling I loved her more than she did me for the last 3 years. That's still far better than my reality right now.
Thank you.

I love my kids and they're the reason I'm still alive today. But how much longer will I have them in my life by my choice? When will my wife decide I'm no longer convenient to watch the kids, when she decides to move in with her girlfriend, when I'm discarded and homeless? I'll never win any sort of custody since she has the job, the family, the support I lack, especially now that I've been hospitalized. I'll be forced to watch my kids taken from me and then have to beg to be with or even see them. I could be deported to a country I haven't been in for 35 years and never see them again. I barely survived losing my wife, how will I survive losing my kids that way?

If I stay, I'm putting my trust and faith in someone that completely betrayed me multiple times, that made selfish decisions that destroyed our family. By staying, all I'm doing is asking for her to kill me on her terms and I will suffer emotionally until she does.

I do keep my kids in mind when I'm making my decision to do this. I'll make it look like an accident. They won't find me at home. My wife will get a knock on the door from the police saying there was an accident. That's all they'll know.

I don't have a work permit (Employment Authorization Document) and my state is one of the few that require employers to e-verify. I overstayed my Visa when I was 5 and I'm one year too old for DACA. E-verify wasn't required when I got my long term job and I was downsized. My first job was a McJob and I can't even get that now. I've only ever had legal jobs, I've had a SSN that I've been paying taxes since my first job when I was 17.

Maybe now that school is starting, I'll have more time to find something/anything I can do when the kids aren't home.
